title: Commercialisation measures at the same research spend
subtitle: Rate ratios per doubling, with research spend as the exposure; 95% intervals
source: National Survey of Research Commercialisation; IP Australia, IP RAPID (lens institutions); notebook 3, section 7.2
note: A ratio of 1.5 per doubling would mean twice the disclosures goes with 1.5 times the patents at the same research spend.
